placeholders.text: MEMORANDUM FOR [Insert Name, Title], Army Contracting Command - Rock Island, [insert office symbol], 3055 Rodman Avenue, Rock Island, Illinois, 61299-8000.
SUBJECT: Appointment as Source Selection Authority (SSA), [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION], [INSERT SOLICITATION NUMBER ].

Pursuant to the authority granted to me under Army Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement, paragraph 5115.303, and Army Contracting Command memorandum subject “Delegation of Authority Number #23-03, Appointment of Senior Contracting Official (SCO)” dated November 28, 2022, acting in my capacity as the SCO for Army Contracting Command - Rock Island, I hereby appoint you, [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE], the SSA for the [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION].

2. The purpose of the [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION] is to [INSERT A DESCRIPTION OF THE REQUIREMENT]. The [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION] will result in [INSERT CONTRACT TYPE AND LENGTH].  The total estimated value of the contract is [INSERT DOLLAR VALUE].
Your authority is limited to this acquisition, and appointment terminates upon successful award of the [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION] and resolution of any protest(s), as applicable.

This appointment as the SSA for the [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUISITION] is to you personally, and you may not redelegate this authority. If, for any reason, you are unable to complete your duties as SSA, please notify me promptly.
